question.text: Gaseous cyclobutene isomerizes to butadiene in a first order process which has a '<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math>' value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math> at <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>153</mn><mo>°</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The time in minutes it takes for the isomerization to proceed <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>40</mn><mo>%</mo></math> to completion at this temperature is_____. (Rounded off to the nearest integer)
